_doc: The bones a rigid gear component's one blend of weights may use, by slot (tools/armor/gear_fit.py rigid_blend). A rigid component (a plate, its rivets) never bends: it takes one blend, B's skin weights averaged over its bound points. That mean takes in every bone her skin there follows (the breast springs, the neck, the clavicle under a cuirass), and the whole plate then swings with each. Here each slot names the roles its plates may ride ("ride") and each role's share of the blend: a number is a fixed share; "mean" is the share that role already has in the mean. With "one_bone" each role's share goes to its strongest bone in the mean (a plate on one bone moves rigidly; a blend of two turning bones shrinks and shears it), else bones keep their proportions from the mean; a role the mean does not reach rides its anchor bone ("{s}" the side the mean leans to). Bones are given roles by the first pattern they match (regex, whole name). A slot not listed keeps the mean as it is. A new slot or a new body's bones need only this file.
